_doc: Model-written statements, for the structural gate the Ollama path applies to
The rule extractor copies a sentence out of the text, so its output is a
sentence by construction and never sees this check. A model writes its own
prose and can hand back a heading, a fragment, or half a sentence that still
reads like English; those are what this gate is for.
keep = statements a model plausibly returns that must survive. They include
short ones ("I use Rust.") and hedged ones ("is considering"): a gate that
drops either costs real facts, and stripping a hedge would state a
drop = the shapes that are not statements. Scored by tests/extraction_quality.rs.
